relation.rationale: Different words (Jnhalt vs Haubtbegriff) used for the same concept.

The variants differ in the spelling of the verb 'erfreuen' (erfrewet vs erſreuet vs erfreuet), specifically involving the presence/absence of 's' and the vowel 'e' vs 'e' (or 'ew' vs 'eu' context), which constitutes a spelling variation of the same grammatical form.
Difference between long s (ſ) and f (f) in the same word form.
The readings differ in verb form: 'jauchtze' and 'jauchze' are singular (3rd person), while 'jauchzen' is plural (3rd person). This is a difference in number.
Difference in the representation of the 'ss' sound (ff vs. ſf) within the same word form.
Difference in the final letter (m vs mb) representing the same word and grammatical form.
